description: OVATION Prime estimates statistical auroral precipitation using satellite-derived relationships. It separates electron and ion auroral categories and supplies an IDL implementation for the near-Earth environment. The resource is documented by JHU APL. The documented physical domain is High Latitude Ionosphere / Auroral Region; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request, Continuous/RT Run (ISWA layout), Continuous/RT Run (ISWA data tree). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. A statistical precipitation distribution is not a direct measure of infrastructure damage. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
